scope: Four completed dev-only experiments; no new model calls, evaluation, or scoring.
storage_policy: Large raw answers, source archives, and cache payloads are external evidence and must not be committed. This file contains paths, hashes, sizes and restoration requirements only.
reproduction_note: Original validation outputs are preserved. Replaying each original checker requires its recorded code and every required external file at the expected paths. Current-byte hashes do not replace historical frozen hashes; restore historical versions wherever they differ. Cache files are archival evidence, while the original checkers read the raw calls embedded in answers.json.
archive_hash_note: The qNNN.npz container hashes are catalogued now; the originally frozen dev archive manifest separately pins decoded source-block hashes. No archive or raw dataset record was decoded for this catalogue.
